div.div:
Flow key:
K1 kubelet <-> API server: register, heartbeat, watch for pod specs
K2 scheduler -> API server: binds a new pod to this node
K3 kubelet -> containerd: start/stop this container
K4 containerd -> ECR: pull the image
K5 aws-node (CNI) -> Pod: assigns a real VPC IP
K6 controller-manager -> API server: watches node heartbeats, updates status
K7 kube-proxy -> Pod: programs iptables so Services can reach it

text.tspan: K1 kubelet <-> API server: register, heartbeat, watch for pod specs
K2 scheduler -> API server: binds a new pod to this node
K3 kubelet -> containerd: start/stop this container
K4 containerd -> ECR: pull the image
K5 aws-node (CNI) -> Pod: assigns a real VPC IP
K6 controller-manager -> API server: watches node heartbeats, updates status
K7 kube-proxy -> Pod: programs iptables so Services can reach it
